name: jev
description: Puts a fast calibrated classifier at the harness boundaries: hands Claude a note about a risky tool call, denies the two block-grade cases once with a reason Claude can answer, flags tool results that read like prompt injection, and catches a turn that stops short of the work it was asked to do. Advisory to the agent, never a prompt to you, and fail-open.

api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
api_key.description: Key for TypeSafe's Jev API, issued at https://typesafe.ai. Without it the judgment hooks stay inactive and only the deterministic pattern checks run.

gate.title: Tool-call gate
gate.description: off: no PreToolUse gate at all. advisory: judge writes outside the project, sensitive paths, unrecognized shell commands and MCP tools with unknown effects, then hand Claude a note about what was scored; the two block-grade cases are denied once with a reason Claude can answer. strict: also judge ordinary edits inside the project, and note the cases advisory mode keeps to itself. You are never prompted in any of the three.

ask_on_trip.title: Ask me when a call is denied
ask_on_trip.description: Turn the tripwire's deny into a permission prompt, so you decide instead of Claude. Off by default: the point of this plugin is that it talks to the agent, not to you. It has no effect in dontAsk or bypassPermissions, where there is no prompt to show.

stop_check.title: Check the final message before stopping
stop_check.description: When the final message of a turn says part of the requested work is unfinished and is not waiting on you, ask Claude to continue. At most one block per prompt.

screen_results.title: Screen fetched text for injected instructions
screen_results.description: Judge WebFetch, WebSearch and MCP tool results for text that gives orders to an AI agent, and tell Claude to treat such a result as data. Never blocks and never rewrites the result.

route_prompts.title: Classify each prompt
route_prompts.description: Add one advisory line naming the kind of task a prompt is asking for, and whether it reads as ambiguous. Off by default: it costs a call on every prompt.

auto_threshold.title: Certainty threshold
auto_threshold.description: Probability at or above which a signal counts as established. Lower means more notes. 0.85 is the default; /jev:calibrate replays your own log at other values.

confidence_threshold.title: Choice confidence threshold
confidence_threshold.description: How peaked a Choice answer's distribution has to be before the prompt-kind line is printed. This is a peakedness statistic, not a probability, so it has its own bar rather than sharing the certainty threshold. Only route_prompts uses it.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: Versioned id the hooks and MCP server send. Pinned so an alias move cannot shift every probability under thresholds you have tuned. Set jev-latest to follow releases.
